title: Interpretation of the Ahom Extract (Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal)
author: Capt. Francis Jenkins
description: Pioneering early nineteenth-century decipherment of an authentic Tai Ahom manuscript extract published in the Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal (Vol. 6). Features direct consultation with native Tai scribes in Upper Assam, establishing the historical identity of the Tai script.
